description: This Java class defines a generic utility for extracting constant topics for message types in a pub/sub system. It provides a static factory method for creating instances with specified topics and implements an interface to retrieve these topics for messages.

classes.name: ConstantTopics
classes.description: A final class implementing PubSubTopicExtractor that returns a fixed set of topics for any message of type T.

methods.name: ConstantTopics
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes the list of constant topics.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance with provided topics, stored as an unmodifiable list.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns the pre-defined list of topics for a given event.
